applies_why: The judge text determines that the D5/C5 verses were answered and names the rounds, so it does not count them as unanswered witnesses.
quote: Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge explicitly says the verses were answered, so K-G4 does not require them to be counted as unanswered witnesses or to quote a pressing sentence.
